record.summary: Regulates internet information services that use 'deep synthesis' technology, defined as the use of deep learning, virtual reality and other generative or synthetic algorithms to produce text, images, audio, video, virtual scenes and other online information (25 articles). Providers must verify users' real identities, review users' inputs and synthesised outputs, and conspicuously label content that may cause public confusion or misidentification. Providers and technical supporters must run security assessments of tools that generate or edit biometric information such as faces and voices. Providers with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity must file their algorithms.
record.notes: Adopted at the CAC office meeting of 3 Nov 2022, signed 25 Nov 2022 and published 11 Dec 2022. Technical supporters must also complete algorithm filing by reference to the provider rules (Art. 19). Its labelling articles (Arts. 16 and 17) are built on by the 2025 Measures for Labeling AI-Generated and Synthetic Content (CN-09), which, with the mandatory standard GB 45438-2025 (CN-08), set more detailed labelling duties from 1 Sept 2025.

verification.note: CAC page stored with the full Chinese text: title, Order No. 12, three issuing bodies, adoption at the CAC office meeting of 3 Nov 2022, signing 25 Nov 2022, effective 10 Jan 2023 and all 25 articles confirmed. judgment.status_reasoning: Order No. 12 promulgates the Provisions with effect from 10 Jan 2023, and Art. 25 repeats the date. That date is before today (14 Oct 2026). The stored files show no amendment or repeal, and the 2025 Labeling Measures (CN-09) cite these Provisions as a legal basis (Arts. 1, 4 and 5) rather than replacing them. Status stays In force.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope with no note: binding AI-specific rules on deep synthesis (generative) services.

changes.summary: Duties now follow the Chinese text. Identity verification (Art. 9), review of inputs and outputs (Art. 10) and labelling (Arts. 16 and 17) bind providers only; the old wording gave them to providers and technical supporters. Security assessments of biometric-editing tools (Art. 15, para. 2, item 1) bind both. Algorithm filing (Art. 19) applies only to providers with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity. 'Deepfakes' (not in the text) replaced by the Art. 23 definition of deep synthesis technology; 'could confuse or mislead' rendered as 'may cause public confusion or misidentification' (可能导致公众混淆或者误认, Art. 17).
changes.notes: Removed the remark on the secondary URL (now in verification.note) and 'Still in force as of Oct 2026' (the status field carries it). Added that technical supporters file by reference (参照, Art. 19, para. 2). Named the related records CN-09 and CN-08.
